ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a leaf cross-section with labels A through H. The large letter B on the left has a pointer line directed into the middle-lower internal tissue made of irregular, loosely packed rounded green cells with air spaces. This region lies below the tall column-like palisade cells and above the lower surface layer. Reasoning: In leaf anatomy, the loose mesophyll tissue with many air spaces beneath the palisade mesophyll is called the spongy mesophyll. Therefore, label B applies to the spongy mesophyll.
